build_LatentClusteringModel: build a LatentClusteringModel with word, item, context, and count dicts to encode and decode dialogue turns
build_ShardedLatentBottleneckModule: build a ShardedLatentBottleneckModule with num shards and clusters to compute soft assignments over latent variables
build_LatentClusteringPredictionModel: build a LatentClusteringPredictionModel that loads a pretrained language model and predicts latent cluster assignments
build_LatentClusteringLanguageModel: build a LatentClusteringLanguageModel that uses a pretrained cluster model to condition language generation on latent states
build_BaselineClusteringModel: build a BaselineClusteringModel with a recurrent memory unit and latent bottleneck for end-to-end dialogue clustering
